mainText: Hello, Verona! At 10 AM, it is 59 degrees under overcast skies at Firemans Park, with a waxing gibbous moon visible in the sky. Please note that the ISS passes overhead tonight, but you won't be able to see it due to the clouds.

The city has announced that crack filling maintenance begins September 28, affecting various streets including South Nine Mound Road and Commerce Parkway. Additionally, the Plan Commission is set to review several development projects, including those at 201 South Main Street and the Sub-Zero facility, on October 5.

Today you can participate in Yoga at Insight Wellness. Looking ahead to tomorrow, there are plenty of options including trivia at Hop Haus, Lake Lou-ee, and Paddy Mac's, plus live music and the Downtown Farmer's Market.
On September 10, officers responded to a burglary in the 600 block of Hunters Cove Way where a 19-year-old was detained following a report of a gunshot and a break-in.
Culver's of Verona is currently closed for a building remodel, so there is no flavor of the day available at this time.
